stories.headline: Netflix sued for $105M after Nicolas Cage WWII thriller goes missing, exposing leak risks - Fox Business
stories.summary: A Swiss producer alleges Netflix lost an unencrypted copy of the unreleased Nicolas Cage film Fortitude, costing the project millions and triggering a $105 million lawsuit.
stories.why: Exposes how even massive studios struggle with basic security of unreleased content—if Netflix can lose an unencrypted film, your data's probably not as safe as you think either.

stories.headline: Rampage Jackson Chokes Out 'Jackass' Star Poopies In Brutal 'Sports Hurts' Clip - TMZ
stories.summary: Rampage Jackson just put a Jackass alum to sleep ... and the Zzz inducing rear-naked choke was all captured on video!
stories.why: Rampage (a legit MMA fighter) putting a Jackass guy to sleep is the exact collision of 'real consequences' vs 'stunt comedy' that's been brewing for years—signals a shift where internet personalities can't just skate by on brand alone.

stories.headline: Horoscope for Friday, July 31, 2026 - Chicago Sun-Times
Sadie Sink’s Secret Role in ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Finally Revealed - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: The 'Stranger Things' star joined Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon for the fourth installment in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
stories.why: Sadie Sink landing a Spider-Man movie signals Marvel's willingness to recast/expand the Spidey universe with fresh faces, meaning no actor is untouchable—matters if you've been waiting for the MCU to shake up its A-list fatigue.

stories.headline: Rumor Roundup: Brock Lesnar retirement, WWE baffled by AEW, Mercedes Moné plan, more! - Cageside Seats
stories.summary: Is Brock Lesnar really retiring, WWE baffled by Tony Khan’s booking, Mercedes Mone switch, babyface Solo Sikoa, SummerSlam winners, Ventura, and more rumors.
stories.why: Brock Lesnar potentially retiring signals wrestling's biggest draw might be done, while the AEW/WWE tension suggests the industry's power structure is genuinely unstable for the first time in 20 years—the consolidation everyone expected might not happen.

stories.headline: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Credits Scene Explained: Will Tom Holland Return in ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ or ‘Secret Wars’? - Variety
stories.summary: The 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' post-credits scene reveals that Tom Holland could be back for 'Avengers: Doomsday' or 'Secret Wars.'
stories.why: The post-credits scene reveal matters because it signals how interconnected MCU movies are now—if you skip Spider-Man thinking it's standalone, you'll miss crucial Avengers plot setup, making attendance feel mandatory rather than optional.
